svg.text: PaidHR: outbound GTM system, end to end
svg.textArea: Source: context/docs/gtm-system.md. Row 1 reads left to right, row 2 right to left, row 3 left to right.
svg.text: 2 Pick the people and write the message

rect.data-content:
1A Context OS
ICP, signal matrix, facts, approved spec

1B Buying signals
• Hiring payroll or HR
• 3+ frontline roles
• Funded in 90 days
• New HR or finance lead

1C Find companies
One row per signal, keyed on domain

Exclude
Customer, open deal, or contacted in 90 days

1E Enrich
Headcount (2 sources), industry, HQ, job posts

Drop or park
Not Nigeria, under 20 or over 200 staff, other industry

1G Size band
• 20 to 100: Standard
• 100 to 200: Enterprise

3A Send the sequence
4 emails and 2 LinkedIn touches over 15 days

3B Sort replies
Webhook, AI tags the intent
Wait for a new signal, back to 1B

3F Weekly review
Replies, meetings and wins by signal, segment, angle

2B Founder or CEO first
20 to 50 staff

2C HR manager first
50 to 200 staff, then finance lead

2D Find people
1 to 2 per company by persona

2E Find and verify email
Waterfall, then verifier

2G Write and QA copy
Angle by segment and signal, facts.md only
Weekly loop: results update the Context OS in GitHub
